semantic.justification: J0Z0KF ports original AttributeConversion::decodeXString, its literal/hex pointer scan and comphelper::string::sanitizeStringSurrogates, plus actual FastAttributeList counted UTF8 Unicode values and optional/defaulted AttributeList string/XString queries. RichStringPortion owns decoded actual SAL Unicode text; RichString preserves ordered text/run portions, attributes and concatenation. Native lowercase-x and four-hex-unit recognition, one-pass underscore escaping, no-marker COW fast paths, marker-triggered first-invalid-surrogate truncation, first-duplicate attributes, missing versus empty and undecoded fallback defaults are retained. Private preserve-space state uses a monotone boolean assignment equivalent to setting true; its unused downstream native role is not repaired with whitespace trimming or a new public getter. Font/phonetic/binary/UNO/edit-engine conversion and finalization, RichStringContext/SharedStringsBuffer, workbook helpers/filter and shell/UI acceptance remain unported. Local direct model-write tests do not claim XLSX parse/import, shared-string lookup, rich formatting, XML context orchestration or independent native compilation.
